_source.event_name: Morbi- Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad- Samvidhan Diwas Edition
_source.description: Rajkot- Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad- Samvidhan Diwas Edition will be organised to spread awareness about various constitutional principles, fundamental rights & duties, Preamble to the Constitution & other parts of the Constitution.

VBYLD is a flagship national platform for youth leadership and civic engagement that brings together promising young leaders from across the country to deliberate on national priorities, exchange innovative ideas, interact with policymakers, domain experts and eminent personalities, and contribute towards the realization of the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047.
Recognizing the continued relevance of parliamentary simulations as one of the most effective methods for promoting democratic participation and policy literacy, this year, the eighth edition i.e. VBYP 2027 will be organised as a dedicated Track under VBYLD 2027, thereby bringing together India's finest young leaders on a common national platform. 
The program me will become a comprehensive leadership development initiative that nurtures constitutional values, democratic participation, public policy understanding, critical thinking, innovation and collaborative leadership. It will provide young citizens with opportunities not only to debate issues of national importance but also to develop practical solutions, build leadership competencies and emerge as active partners in India's developmental journey.
Aligned with the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047, the Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament under VBYLD aims to create a nationwide movement of informed, responsible and future-ready young leaders who possess a deep understanding of democratic institutions, appreciate the values enshrined in the Constitution of India, and are equipped to contribute meaningfully to policy discourse, public service and nation-building. The initiative seeks to institutionalize youth participation in democratic processes while strengthening the culture of dialogue, innovation and responsible citizenship across the country.
Structure:
1. District Level: In all 786 districts.
Eligibility: 18-25 years (cut-off date being 17 August, 2026)
Proposed Topics:
• At District-level: “Nasha Mukt Yuva For Viksit Bharat" Time - Three Minutes
Language- Multilingual

Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvaad - Samvidhan Diwas Edition is being organised on the occasion of Samvidhan Diwas. The Samvaad aims to bring together youth and students on a common platform to celebrate the spirit of the Constitution, promote constitutional values, nurture leadership qualities and encourage active participation in nation-building.
The programme will focus on Samvidhan & Constitutional Values, Youth Leadership, Education & Opportunities, and Sustainable Development.
Through meaningful interactions, knowledge-sharing and youth engagement, the initiative seeks to inspire young leaders to contribute towards a stronger, inclusive, self-reliant and developed Bharat.
Date: 24 November 2026 to 26 November 2026
Time: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Venue: Block B, kanji Ullar.Shopian, Jammu & Kashmir.
Note: Refreshment and Certificates will be provided to all attendees.
Youth. Samvidhan. Strong Bharat.

_source.event_name: Jammu Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad programme-Samvidhan Diwas Edition dition
_source.event_address: CMH college of legal studies chowadhi Top Jammu
_source.description:
The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, through MY Bharat, is organisingthe Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad Programme under the special theme "Nasha Mukt Yuva for
Viksit Bharat" on 26th November (Constitution Day) at 500+ Law Colleges spanning 30+
States/UTs and 600+ districts.
The programme aims to empower young citizens by connecting them with the vision of Viksit
Bharat@2047, while creating awareness about the harmful effects of substance abuse and encouraging
youth to become ambassadors of a drug-free India.
To be conducted in collaboration with universities and colleges across the country, the programme will
serve as an effective platform for engaging students through awareness sessions, interactive dialogues,
and digital participation on the MY Bharat platform. By integrating the national vision of
development with the message of a drug-free society, the initiative seeks to inspire youth to
contribute meaningfully towards nation-building.
The programme reflects the vision of the Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, who has
consistently emphasised the pivotal role of youth in achieving the goal of a developed, self-reliant,
and drug-free India by 2047.


Objectives
The Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad Programme aims to:
● Connect youth with the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 through structured engagement and
civic participation.
● Create awareness among young people about the adverse social, physical, psychological, and economic impacts of substance abuse
● Encourage youth to actively support the national mission of building a Nasha Mukt Bharat
as a prerequisite for a developed India.
● Promote digital participation and onboarding on the MY Bharat Portal.
● Strengthen volunteerism and build a nationwide network of socially responsible youth
contributing towards nation-building.

Programme Highlights
● Youth Icons, including State Champions of VBYLD 2025, winners of the Viksit Bharat Youth
Parliament, NSS Awardees, National Youth Awardees, and other distinguished youth leaders.

_source.event_name: GB Nagar - Noida Block - Neighbourhood Youth Parliament
_source.event_address: Shri Ram Chandra Mission, Sector 167, Chhaproli Khadar, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304
_source.description:
With the objective of fostering youth participation in addressing social challenges and contributing to the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047, MY Bharat, Gautam Budh Nagar, proposes to organise a Neighborhood Youth Parliament on the theme “Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat”, in collaboration with schools, colleges and youth clubs.

The programme will feature the following activities:

--Awareness Session: An expert-led session in collaboration with the CMO Office on substance abuse prevention, Nasha Mukt Yuva, TB Mukt Bharat and inspiring stories of positive change.

--Nukkad Natak: Street plays by students to spread awareness about substance abuse prevention and TB Mukt Bharat.

--Painting and Slogan Writing Competitions: Creative competitions to encourage awareness about a drug-free society, healthy lifestyles and responsible citizenship.

--Nasha Mukt Yuva Pledge: A collective pledge by participants to stay away from substance abuse and actively promote a healthy and drug-free society.

Certificates and Incentives:

--Participation certificates for participants.

--Coffee mugs for Nukkad Natak participants.

--Coffee mugs for the top five winners each in Painting and Slogan Writing competitions.

The event aims to empower young people as responsible citizens and change-makers, encouraging them to actively contribute towards Nasha Mukt Yuva, TB Mukt Bharat and the realisation of Viksit Bharat @2047.
